```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
```

## Load Results

```{r load}
results <- read_csv("../data/results/pipeline_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Mean across trials
summary_mean <- results |>
  group_by(phenotype, model) |>
  summarise(
    mean_f1          = mean(f1,              na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_f1            = sd(f1,                na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_f1_aa       = mean(f1_aa,           na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_recall      = mean(recall,          na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_precision   = mean(precision,       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_res_rate    = mean(resolution_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trials         = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(summary_mean, digits = 3, caption = "Mean metrics across trials")
```

## F1 by Phenotype and Model

```{r f1_plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ggplot(summary_mean, aes(x = phenotype, y = mean_f1, fill = model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_f1 - sd_f1, ymax = mean_f1 + sd_f1),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("claude_opus_4_6" = "#D55E00",
                                "gemini_flash"    = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(title = "Exact F1 by Phenotype and Model",
       x = "Phenotype", y = "Mean F1 (± SD)", fill = "Model") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

## Exact vs Ancestor-Aware F1

```{r aa_plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
summary_mean |>
  select(phenotype, model, mean_f1, mean_f1_aa) |>
  pivot_longer(c(mean_f1, mean_f1_aa), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
    "mean_f1"    = "Exact F1",
    "mean_f1_aa" = "Ancestor-aware F1"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = phenotype, y = value, fill = interaction(model, metric))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  labs(title = "Exact vs Ancestor-Aware F1",
       x = "Phenotype", y = "Mean F1", fill = "Model × Metric") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

## Resolution Rate

```{r resolution}
ggplot(summary_mean, aes(x = phenotype, y = mean_res_rate, fill = model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("claude_opus_4_6" = "#D55E00",
                                "gemini_flash"    = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(title = "Concept Name Resolution Rate (%)",
       subtitle = "% of LLM-generated names successfully resolved by SQL lookup",
       x = "Phenotype", y = "Resolution Rate (%)", fill = "Model") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

## Per-Trial Detail

```{r per_trial}
kable(results[, c("phenotype","model","trial","f1","f1_aa",
                   "precision","recall","resolution_rate","fp","fn")],
      digits = 3,
      caption = "Per-trial results")
```
